title: Reseed never seeds global silo stalk/roots, desyncing the earned-Bean snapshot denominator

location.code_snippet:
// only per-account stalk and per-token balances are written;
// s.sys.silo.stalk, s.sys.silo.roots, and s.accts[account].roots are never set here

description: The earned-Bean snapshot distribution in LibSilo._balanceOfEarnedBeans computes an account's claimable Beans as `s.sys.silo.stalk * s.accts[account].roots / s.sys.silo.roots - s.accts[account].stalk` (LibSilo.sol#689). The global denominators `s.sys.silo.stalk` and `s.sys.silo.roots` are the system-wide snapshot totals. A full scan of beanstalk/init/ shows that NO reseed/init contract ever writes `s.sys.silo.stalk` or `s.sys.silo.roots` (the only non-mock writers are LibReceiving.siloReceive, LibSilo.mint/burnActiveStalk, and LibGerminate.endTotalGermination — all live-operation paths, not migration seeding). ReseedSilo writes only per-account `s.accts[account].stalk` and per-token `s.sys.silo.balances[token]`. Account roots are likewise never seeded in the reseed path. The result is a snapshot whose per-account numerators and the system denominators are populated by different code paths that are not reconciled at the migration boundary: either the global totals are left at zero/stale (every earned-Bean and burnActiveStalk computation reverts on div-by-zero or returns garbage), or they are seeded by an out-of-scope global-reseed step to a value that does not equal sum(account.stalk) once SN-001 has corrupted the per-account values. Total Stalk != sum(account Stalk) and Total Roots != sum(account Roots) at relaunch.
impact: The earned-Bean snapshot is mis-scaled for the entire protocol after migration. _balanceOfEarnedBeans (LibSilo.sol#689) divides by s.sys.silo.roots; if it is 0 the function returns early (0 earned Beans for everyone) or, once seeded inconsistently, mis-distributes every season's minted Beans because the per-account roots numerators do not sum to the global roots denominator. burnActiveStalk (LibSilo.sol#244) and transfer (LibSilo.sol#298) also divide by s.sys.silo.stalk. A denominator that does not match the migrated per-account weights either bricks withdrawals/transfers (div underflow/inconsistent subtraction) or systematically over-/under-credits earned Beans, redistributing real Bean value among stalkholders.

ite.intent: The migrated silo snapshot must satisfy global total == sum of per-account weights so earned-Bean distribution is conserved; it does not.
ite.technique: ReseedSilo writes only per-account stalk and per-token balances; the global s.sys.silo.stalk/roots denominators consumed by _balanceOfEarnedBeans are never reconciled to the migrated account weights.
ite.evasion: Per-token require()s validate deposit totals only; there is no global stalk/roots conservation check across the reseed.

ice_chain.corrupted_state: s.sys.silo.roots / s.sys.silo.stalk (global snapshot denominators) and per-account roots
ice_chain.consumer_action: computes each stalkholder's claimable share of season-minted Beans; a desynced denominator mis-distributes or blocks all earned Beans
